mission54b1.rootCause: mouth radius came from each portal own size while slots were spaced 2piR/N; coplanar equidistant discs tied in the raycast and the tie was broken by traversal order
mission54b1.fix: mouth radius derived from nearest-neighbour distance (<=0.45d), extras clustered in orbits, ring fitted to the narrower screen axis

remaining.candidate1: screen-space overlap under a grazing camera is not covered by a ring-plane guarantee
remaining.candidate2: harness clicked 44px off centre and read the field while the camera was moving (studio projected far off screen while onScreen said 11)

harnessBugs: orb is a toggle and was pressed every settle
window.__leluImmersive is not set in this build
three canvases on the page; only one draws the field

verdict.C: CONFIRMED - Core camera rotates every frame, projections stale

mission54b2.blocker: the app never enters immersive mode in this environment, so the home HUD covers the canvas and pointer clicks never reach the Genesis canvas
mission54b2.nextStep: assert data-immersive === true before any attempt (or measure on a surface with no HUD), then read __leluPortalEvents[-1].delivered.portalId

camera.cause: GenesisCameraController lerps OrbitControls target every frame with damping

verdict.A: ruled out - no R3F event produced
verdict.E: confirmed primary cause - UI layer intercepts the click

mission54b3.nextStep: make immersive chrome non-interactive where the field is drawn, then rerun probe-settled-targets.mjs and read __leluPortalEvents.at(-1).delivered.portalId

mission54b6.rootCause: portal mouth attached only R3F onClick, which is synthesised from a pointerdown/up pair resolved on one frame; a fast press produced no activation (measured 6/10), and delivered clicks were refused because the entry flight still owned the camera
change: beginPress records pointer id + start point and takes pointer capture
endPress activates only for the same pointer released within 18px
single activate() path preserves the trace and the busyElsewhere guard
activations within 500ms collapse so pointer-up and click cannot double-fire
